legacy_root.title: Discrepancy triage router that cannot close a discrepancy without a disposition
legacy_root.question: Implementation target: route every recorded discrepancy (spec 11039) into exactly one disposition - implementation-defect, confirmation-defect, specification-ambiguity, environment-difference, or accepted-residual - and open a severity-tagged defect for the first two. Question: can any discrepancy currently reach a closed state without a disposition, and does the router block that?
legacy_root.answer: Yes, before the gate: naive_close() sets status=closed and leaves disposition null, so a discrepancy can reach a closed state without a disposition (corpus silent-closed count=0, plus the planted naive_close control). After the gate is armed: no. close() refuses a null/blank disposition, persist() refuses a silent close, accepted-residual without a named settling experiment is refused, and a fully dispositioned close with a second confirmer succeeds in the same run. implementation-defect and confirmation-defect each open a severity-tagged defect. The implementer may contest in writing and cannot close; the confirmation author cannot close either.

defect.title: A discrepancy could reach status=closed with disposition=null via naive JSON mutation; the router now refuses that close.

first_observation.note: Pre-gate JSON mutation: a discrepancy reached closed without a disposition.

later_observation.output: close(disposition=None) raised REFUSED:null-disposition; fully dispositioned close succeeded
later_observation.note: Armed router: silent close refused and a routed close succeeded in the same run.

legacy_root.residual: command-center/RISK-REGISTER.md is absent on this worktree, so defect severity uses the closed P0-P3 set rather than a cited rubric clause. _USER-PROMPTS.md:11039 is also absent; the five-disposition set is taken from the CNF-0013 catalog entry. CNF-0001 has not landed confirmation-receipt.schema.json; this unit authored discrepancy-record.schema.json so the router artifact can parse against its declared output_schema. Live confirmation/receipts corpus silent-closed count is 0 of 0 scanned matching records (empty-set reported explicitly, not read as a pass of the corpus). The measured hole is the missing close gate, demonstrated by naive_close and closed by arming tools/command-center/discrepancy_router.py.
